scope: Selected 64-column bank with one pixel row; typical process and nominal supply/wire. Not full-chip or exhaustive corner qualification.

automation.available_command_scope: Validate retained report identity and regenerate the journal result tables; does not run DRC, LVS, SPICE, or raw-evidence audits.
blockers: Build and audit contracts contain fixed 40 µm pitch, pin coordinates and transistor/diode dimensions.
Full-bank auditors require the original dated plan and ground-only geometry comparison.
Existing launchers require old baseline hashes and use fixed published report filenames.
Process/supply settings and matched-reference helpers must be parameterized consistently.
Raw traces, upstream device GDS and installed PDK are not all contained in the Git checkpoint.

history.title: Compact pixel, capture column and small joined controls
history.detail: Established scoped geometry/connectivity and small-circuit screens; retained failed attempts and extraction limitations.

history.title: Ground-return diagnosis and timing correction
history.detail: An 8 µm bus alone failed selected readout at 1994.440 µV. Distributed return with 10 µs acquisition still failed at 547.178 µV; the same layout with 12 µs acquisition passed the selected diagnostic at 269.281 µV.

history.title: First full-bank pairs
history.detail: 27 °C alternating and 125 °C inverse passed; four transients and 384 references. A validated reuse path retained the completed nominal transient and references.

history.title: Crossed temperature/pattern pairs
history.detail: Added 27 °C inverse and 125 °C alternating; alternating/inverse matrix reached eight transients and 768 references.

history.title: Uniform dark
history.detail: Both temperatures passed, four transients and 384 references; 4.04 hours including audits.

history.title: Uniform middle
history.detail: Both temperatures passed, four transients and 384 references; 3.65 hours including audits.

history.title: Bright and automatic joint placement reviewed
history.detail: Bright completed in 3.97 hours; joint far-node placement completed in 3.87 hours. All four plots reviewed and 3347 evidence files verified. Total selected bank coverage: 24 transients and 2304 references.

history.title: Living verification record
history.detail: Added this catalogue, report-linked results and rerun dependency guide. This refresh command does not launch simulations; a general layout-to-results controller remains to be implemented.

history.title: Journal embedded; first process-variation batch launched
history.detail: Placed the expandable journal first in the overview. Fourteen process/watcher tests pass and the retained hot audit reproduces exactly. Small SS passes; small FF fails total accuracy at 1240.756 µV with a late-storage-drift indication. Started four current-layout SS/FF hot-inverse transients and 384 references; results pending. No accuracy limits changed.

history.title: Process batch completed: both total-error checks fail
history.detail: All four simulations and 384 references completed in 2.92 hours. SS total error 512.924 µV, FF 2000.323 µV against 500 µV; tracking/refinement/contrast pass. Reviewed both plots and verified 1740 evidence files. Next: separate SS settling from FF retention and measure storage-terminal currents with bounded DC probes.

history.title: Storage leakage isolated; short candidate screens completed
history.detail: Five balanced zero-volt current probes identify the NMOS capture switch as the dominant FF storage discharge path. Six length and four series-stack model-only DC cases complete; three devices reduce tested net leakage by about 70%. No layout or accuracy-qualified correction. Next: complete capture/readout transients for candidates and an SS acquisition-timing test.

history.title: Capture-switch candidates complete full small-bank cycles
history.detail: 20 fresh transients and 120 matched references reviewed. Three series NMOS devices pass the selected typical/SS/FF screen at 125 °C; FF total error falls from 1240.756 to 410.653 µV. Two devices still fail at 596.505 µV. Original-switch SS acquisition extension 12→12.5 µs reduces tracking from 281.789 to 206.737 µV. Model-only; physical and full-bank fixes remain pending. Four guard tests and all evidence hashes pass.

history.title: Physical three-device capture candidate passes small-bank verification
history.detail: Combined timing/model checks pass, followed by a separate physical nine-MOS column and 26-MOS/two-pixel bank. Magic/KLayout DRC, direct/collapsed LVS and 40 um abutment pass. Column outline and upper storage geometry are unchanged. Across port/far extractions, worst total errors are typical 152.197, SS 181.071 and FF 258.782 uV. Placement sensitivity <0.044 uV. This stage adds 18 transients and 108 references; the existing 64-column checkpoint and its process failures remain unchanged.

history.title: Launch physical 64-column candidate and gated continuation
history.detail: Prior verified checkpoint committed and pushed as 06889e5. New 770-MOS bank passes physical checks and all 64 capture chains. Six fresh small controls reproduce retained results. Begin typical/SS/FF hot inverse tests, then advance only on independent passes through mixed corners, room temperature and typical illumination. Queue totals 18 cases, 36 transients and 3456 references; results pending. Original baseline qualification stays unchanged.

history.title: Review interrupted 64-column candidate: FF error remains
history.detail: Three coarse transients and 576 references independently audited; all fine runs hit the four-hour watchdog with 11 samples missing. Typical/SS coarse totals 391.959/445.375 µV meet limits, FF 602.413 µV does not. Available fine data contains 7 FF failures. No complete paired pass or queue continuation; next address FF retention and runtime budget.

history.title: Five-device candidate passes physical and small-bank preflight
history.detail: Model-only extended-age screen: FF 604.318 → 396.116 uV. Implement separate five-device column and banks; physical DRC/LVS and unchanged storage geometry pass. Twelve extracted port/far transients and 72 references pass. Full-bank electrical coverage remains pending; new gated runner uses 3 workers and an 8-hour transient watchdog.

history.title: Launch five-device overnight process sequence
history.detail: Detached three-worker queue started after passing physical and small-bank preflight. Initial FF/SS/typical hot inverse stage; mixed corners, room-temperature inverse and remaining typical patterns gated on independent passes. 18 cases / 36 transients / 3456 references planned. Eight-hour transient watchdog; desktop completion/review alert enabled. Results pending.
